   313	 * Used by getProjectManagerHandoff to route READY work packages to the correct agent.
   314	 */
   315	function readyStatusForAgent(assignedTo: string | null): string {
   316	  return READY_STATUS_FOR_ROLE[assignedTo as AgentRole] ?? 'READY_FOR_DEVELOPER';
   317	}

   323	 * 1. Non-dependency blockers (decision/external/technical) → IN_PROGRESS (PM must act)
   324	 * 2. READY WPs → route to assigned agent via readyStatusForAgent

   329	  // Step 1: Non-dependency blockers — PM must resolve before work can continue.
   330	  // Dependency-blocked WPs (blocked_by absent or blocked_by.type === 'dependency') are
   331	  // skipped — they are gated on other WPs completing, not on PM intervention.

   334	      !isTerminalStatus(wp.status) &&
   335	      wp.status === 'BLOCKED' &&

   337	      ['decision', 'external', 'technical'].includes(wp.blocked_by.type)
   338	    ) {
   339	      return buildHandoffResponse(
   340	        'Project Manager',
   341	        'IN_PROGRESS',
   342	        `Blocker resolution required: ${wp.work_package_id} is BLOCKED by a ${wp.blocked_by.type} issue — "${wp.blocked_by.description}". Project Manager must resolve before work can continue.`,
   343	        undefined,
   344	        projectPath,
   345	        store
   346	      );
   347	    }
   348	  }
   349	
   350	  // Step 2: READY WPs → route to the agent assigned to that work package.
   351	  // Unassigned WPs route to the agent owning the WP's first active stage (§13.1).
   352	  for (const wp of wpDetails) {
   353	    if (wp.status === 'READY') {
   354	      const targetAgent =
   355	        wp.assigned_to ??
   356	        PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP[
   357	          firstActiveStage(
   358	            (wp.active_pipeline_stages as PipelineType[] | undefined) ?? null
   359	          )
   360	        ];

   362	      return buildHandoffResponse(
   363	        'Project Manager',
   364	        status,
   365	        `Work package ${wp.work_package_id} is READY. Routing to ${targetAgent} (${wp.assigned_to ? 'assigned' : 'first active stage'}).`,

   367	        projectPath,
   368	        store
   369	      );

   371	  }
   372	
   373	  // Step 2b: IN_PROGRESS WPs needing next pipeline stage (§13.1 step 2b)
   374	  // Fires only when step 2 finds no READY WPs. Scans each non-terminal, non-dependency-blocked
   375	  // IN_PROGRESS WP for a pipeline stage that has not yet PASSed and is safe to start.
   376	  // Covers both (a) stage-transition routing and (b) freshly-claimed WPs with zero pipelines.
   377	  for (const wp of wpDetails) {
   378	    if (isTerminalStatus(wp.status) || wp.status !== 'IN_PROGRESS') continue;
   379	    if (isBlockedByDependencies(wp)) continue;
   380	
   381	    const activeStages = getOrderedActiveStages(
   382	      (wp.active_pipeline_stages as PipelineType[] | undefined) ?? [...DEFAULT_PIPELINE_STAGES]
   383	    );
   384	
   385	    for (const stage of activeStages) {
   386	      // Check the most recent non-auto-cancelled pipeline for this stage
   387	      const matching = wp.pipelines.filter(p => p.type === stage && !p.auto_cancelled);
   388	      const mostRecent = matching.at(-1);
   389	
   390	      if (mostRecent?.status === 'PASS') continue; // stage done, check next
   391	
   392	      // First stage not yet PASS — apply guards before routing
   393	      if (mostRecent?.status === 'FAIL') break; // FAIL routing handled by downstream agent's own handoff

   403	      }

81	export type PostImplPipelineType = 'qa' | 'code-review' | 'documentation';
    82	
    83	/**
    84	 * Legacy static prerequisite map for the default-stage workflow.
    85	 * Only includes entries for the default stages — new-style WPs should use
    86	 * resolvePrerequisite(). null means no prerequisite (can always start).
    87	 *
    88	 * Derived from `pipelines.default_stages` in the shared workflow manifest:
    89	 * each stage's prerequisite is its immediately preceding stage in the default
    90	 * order (or null for the first stage). This intentionally diverges from the
    91	 * full 6-stage `pipelines.prerequisites` map, which reflects the complete
    92	 * canonical chain including optional stages.
    93	 */
    94	export const PIPELINE_PREREQUISITES: Partial<Record<PipelineType, PipelineType | null>> =
    95	  Object.fromEntries(
    96	    (workflowManifest.pipelines.default_stages as readonly PipelineType[]).map((stage, i, arr) => [
    97	      stage,
    98	      i === 0 ? null : (arr[i - 1] ?? null),
    99	    ])
   100	  );
   101	
   102	/**
   103	 * Map of pipeline type to the agent role that owns it.
   104	 * Used to automatically update assigned_to when a pipeline starts.
   105	 *
   106	 * Derived from `roles[].pipeline` (non-null) → `roles[].name` in the shared
   107	 * workflow manifest.
   108	 */
   109	export const PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP: Record<PipelineType, string> = Object.fromEntries(
   110	  workflowManifest.roles
   111	    .filter(r => r.pipeline !== null)
   112	    .map(r => [r.pipeline, r.name])
   113	) as Record<PipelineType, string>;
   114	
   115	/**
   116	 * Legacy static next-agent map for the 4-stage default workflow.
   117	 * Partial so that new PipelineType values do not require entries here.
   118	 * New-style WPs should use resolveNextAgent().
   119	 *
   120	 * Derived at runtime from PIPELINE_TYPES and PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP, using the
   121	 * default stage set. Entries not in the default stages are excluded.
   122	 */
   123	export const NEXT_AGENT_MAP: Partial<Record<PipelineType, string>> = (() => {
   124	  const defaultStages = workflowManifest.pipelines.default_stages as readonly PipelineType[];
   125	  const result: Partial<Record<PipelineType, string>> = {};
   126	  for (let i = 0; i < defaultStages.length - 1; i++) {
   127	    const current = defaultStages[i]!;
   128	    const next = defaultStages[i + 1]!;
   129	    result[current] = PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP[next];
   130	  }
   131	  // Last stage in default order always hands off to Synthesis
   132	  const lastStage = defaultStages[defaultStages.length - 1];
   133	  if (lastStage) result[lastStage] = _SYNTHESIS_ROLE;
   134	  return result;
   135	})();
   136	
   137	/**
   138	 * Legacy static fail-routing map for the default-stage workflow.
   139	 * Partial so that new PipelineType values do not require entries here.
   140	 * New-style WPs should use resolveFailAgent().
   141	 *
   142	 * Derived from `pipelines.fail_routing` in the shared workflow manifest.
   143	 * The manifest stores role IDs; they are translated to role names via the
   144	 * roles array lookup built at module load time.
   145	 *
   146	 * Cross-ref: `developerReworkTypes` in workflow-helpers.ts is derived from
   147	 * this map at runtime so the two cannot silently diverge.
   148	 */
   149	export const FAIL_ROUTING_MAP: Partial<Record<PipelineType, string>> = Object.fromEntries(
   150	  (workflowManifest.pipelines.default_stages as readonly string[]).map(stage => [
   151	    stage,
   152	    _roleById[(workflowManifest.pipelines.fail_routing as Record<string, string>)[stage] ?? ''] ?? _DEVELOPER_ROLE,
   153	  ])
   154	);
   155	
   156	/**
   157	 * Inverse of PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP: maps an agent role to the pipeline type it owns.
   158	 * Derived at runtime from PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP so the two can never silently diverge.
   159	 * Constructed via PIPELINE_TYPES iteration with an explicit tuple return type so
